caption: The drawing features a single, dark-colored overcoat as the main object, rendered with shading to indicate folds and depth in the fabric. The overcoat is double-breasted with six dark buttons visible on the front, arranged in two vertical rows. It has wide lapels, and stitching details are visible around the collar and down the center of the coat. The coat is long, extending past the knees, with slightly flared cuffs that include three smaller buttons on each sleeve. The interior lining at the neck is a lighter color, possibly light pink or beige, with visible stitched seams. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is a simple line sketch of the coat shown from the back, providing a view of its general shape and seam placement. The background of the image is plain and off-white in color.
title: Coat
